description: Finish the Chibi Sprouts release 1 cast on the approved Kim base: Dad, Grandma and Grandpa as adult variants, and Tom and Lily on a new child base, with one proportion pin and one independent look judge per character, and no customer-facing claim
deviation_notes: Created 2026-11-25 from QUEUE.md item 3 and the Mom shape approval (redesign plan T12; judge.json identity 7.5 and proportion 8.5). The track takes the lightest gates of the PM rule of 2026-11-25: one phase per group, one proportion pin and one look judge per character, no Review A, B or C, and one adversarial round because two scripts change. Amendment round 1 answers every finding F1 to F13 of the spec review b58aad2: one build plus the two level renders and no forge all, a prepared worktree output tree, TABLES as ordered name-lo-hi arrays with the selected table authoritative, a rounded projected crown with a one-sided mask guard and two new fixtures, a defined panel command line and layout with a 56 px headroom and a relative-height cast sheet, destination checks on every parent and file, fixed versus measured landmarks with tolerances and an inventory pin, an asset face layer with a faceMarks eye exclusion, three-family judge separation with verdict binding and a two-round limit, an adversarial pass before Phase 2, T19 as a PM-owned human gate, the light lane in metadata, the Mom sheet rendering conventions, the correct Mom shape citation, and the baseline isolation pin. No character work starts at track creation. The spec review was not run in this delegated session; the orchestrator ran it on b58aad2 and 82a2a26, and amendment rounds 1 and 2 answer it. Amendment round 2 answers the second review (spec-review-82a2a26.json): the existing measurePixels five-item API and the detail.crownRow mask-top field stay, with the two new fixtures behind the exported measureFigure seam (F4); the panel defines the horizontal crop, the head-fit rule, and a sheet-only route that writes no panel (F5); the child skeleton count is 17 with a BASE_JOINTS inspection seam and a declared variants.hair colour (F7); the face layer rebuilds the published KIM head, recreates the eye paint, and reads a typed castMeta export whose colours stay clear of the iris (F8); every judge input is re-verified at each gate, including the shared child base revision (F9); T19 uses the checked human-gate form with deferred:pm and the optional Review A clause is removed (F10); stats equality uses a stable projection without elapsed times and the final hashes are taken after the lit render (F14); the child-base Red cases move to Phase 3 so Phase 1 leaves a passing tool suite (F15); the phase base and each audited HEAD are separate records (F16); the historical Mom shape route is cited correctly (F17); and the approved judge upload and the generated-file replacements are the stated exceptions (F18). The track makes no customer-facing claim.
